name: mstack-claude-pm-codex-dev
description: Claude-led workflow in which Codex writes the code: Claude briefs one Codex developer per phase through the OpenAI Codex plugin, reads each diff, reruns the validation, gets the advisor's and a read-only Codex review, sends findings back to the same Codex thread, and commits each accepted phase to one integration branch delivered as one pull request. Claude Code only.
